test_title: PYST 47: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 24 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Anu, Beena, Deepa, Heena, Kareena, Leena and Reena sit in a straight line, facing north. Kareena sits third to the right of Beena, who sits second to the right of Deepa. Reena sits to the immediate left of Leena. Anu sits second to the left of Heena. Three of the following four are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which among the following do NOT belong to that group?
solution:
Given: Anu, Beena, Deepa, Heena, Kareena and Reena sit in a straight line, facing north.

1) Kareena sits third to the right of Beena, who sits second to the right of Deepa.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a099b06d4d9723fd1c1ece1e4b2b578269d6714aa8e2fa5fa12a9fda50dac2f.png] 

2) Reena sits to the immediate left of Leena.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8b90d66a93dacb409015b51ee62dce21298d4f44662f0d9dd9d3bfe23613a3d.png] 

3) Anu sits second to the left of Heena.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f1141c636159a3569dd4b1248980181cec45844e07d1c600e9a192f13462c953.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement:

Option 1) Leena and Kareena → Immediate neighbours 

Option 2) Anu and Deepa → Immediate neighbours

Option 3) Beena and Reena → Immediate neighbours

Option 4) Heena and Reena → **Heena sits second to the left of Renna**

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
